Ormskirk railway station in Ormskirk, Lancashire, England, is an interchange between Merseyrail services from Liverpool Central and Northern services from Preston on the Ormskirk branch line, 12+3/4 mi northeast of Liverpool. The station building and three arch road bridge are both Grade II listed structures.
